title: Hospital Accounts Reached by a Renewal — Notice Day Allowance
content:
The response days of a renewal's missing-information notice under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) grow with the number of the patient's Riverbend accounts the renewal reaches, counted as the first post-discharge summary statements issued on the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) accounts in the 12 whole months before the notice date. For the account count, a statement belongs to those months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its statement date from the notice date, a whole month running from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it.

| First summary statements in the 12 months | Days added |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 10 |
| at least 3 and fewer than 5 | 5 |
| fewer than 3 | none |

**Hypothetical.** Four first statements in the 12 months add 5 days; a fifth one adds 10 in place of 5; two add none.
